_doc: Simulated Smart-Tagging-like SET PIECES intervals for external (DFL) halves. Restarts = first alive frame after each dead run of the clean DFL labels; type from ball position at the restart (geometry, metres, origin centre); team = possessor after the restart, except throw-ins which are always N (DATA.md: every throw-in tagged N/A). All noise values are ASSUMPTIONS (DATA.md: tags are automatic, with false positives and negatives; no rates published).
_geometry: first restart of each half = Kick Off (Start); later restarts: kick-off (after goal) within 5 m of the centre spot; corner: within 3 m of goal line and 4 m of touchline; goal kick: within 7 m of goal line and |y|<10 m; throw-in: within 2.5 m of touchline; else free kick (includes drop balls/penalties).
_window: decoder-7d / starter/load_smart_tagging.py: only fact is a ~5 s window around the restart that contains it. Window length ~U(lo,hi) s, restart at a uniform position inside, then jitter. No fixed offset.
_phases: Phase tags (DATA.md: 'intervals are phases, not possessions; a Build Up can span one possession, stop short of one, or cover two'). Possessions = min_control(phase_tau_s) of clean labels; split by ball third relative to the attacking team's direction (from team mean x per half). Transition pair for the first transition_s after a turnover in open play. All rates ASSUMPTIONS.
_phase_count_per_match: FACT DATA.md Smart Tagging counts for the target match (density only). Per half: keep the longest phases of each attacking code, N ~ Poisson(count/2); the defending code is kept on the longest of those (paired: BUILD UP<->DEFENDING IN ATTACKING THIRD 22/22, PROGRESSION<->MIDDLE 66/66, FINAL THIRD 93 -> DEFENSIVE THIRD 30, transitions 24/24).
